messages.body_plain:
I've been configuring RApache in my rapache.conf file like so: LoadModule R_module /etc/httpd/modules/mod_R.so SetHandler r-info SetHandler r-script RHandler sys.source SetHandler r-script RHandler brew::brew I placed a hello-world.R file with the following code inside the /var/www/html/rscripts directory: setContentType("text/html") cat("

") cat("Hello from R!") cat("

") DONE However, when I navigate to mywebsite.com/rscripts/ I get a download dialog from my browser like this one: ​ I thought RApache was supposed to execute .R files with the proper .conf setup? Google searching hasn't turned up any leads. Any ideas? Your help is much appreciated.

LoadModule R_module /etc/httpd/modules/mod_R.so
